WITH RECURSIVE bom_latest AS ( SELECT father_id, bom_ver, data_status FROM ( SELECT father_id, bom_ver, data_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY father_id ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bom_ver, '_V', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) DESC ) AS rn FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` WHERE data_status = '已审核' AND TRIM(son_no) = '1' ) x WHERE rn = 1 ), bom_tree AS ( -- 锚点：根节点，JOIN 全局最新版 SELECT 0 AS level_no, TRIM(t.`son_no`) AS son_no, t.`bom_id` AS bom_id, t.`father_id` AS father_id, t.`s_material_name` AS father_name, TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS current_code, t.`s_material_name` AS current_name, TRIM(t.`son_id`) AS son_id, t.`s_material_name` AS son_name, TRIM(t.`unit`) AS unit, CAST(NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM(t.`fenzi`), ',', ''), '') AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS fenzi, CAST(NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM(t.`fenmu`), ',', ''), '') AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS fenmu, CAST(TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS CHAR(1000)) AS path, CAST(CONCAT(TRIM(t.`father_id`), '#1') AS CHAR(2000)) AS cycle_key, t.`bom_ver` AS bom_ver, l.`data_status` AS data_status FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t JOIN bom_latest l ON t.`father_id` = l.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = l.`bom_ver` WHERE t.`father_id` = #{rootFatherId} AND t.`data_status` = '已审核'
UNION ALL
-- 递归：子项变父项，JOIN bom_latest 取该子项的最新版，再展开它的子项 SELECT b.level_no + 1, TRIM(t.`son_no`) AS son_no, t.`bom_id` AS bom_id, t.`father_id` AS father_id, b.current_name AS father_name, TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS current_code, t.`s_material_name` AS current_name, TRIM(t.`son_id`) AS son_id, t.`s_material_name` AS son_name, TRIM(t.`unit`) AS unit, CAST(NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM(t.`fenzi`), ',', ''), '') AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS fenzi, CAST(NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM(t.`fenmu`), ',', ''), '') AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS fenmu, CAST(CONCAT(b.path, ' -> ', TRIM(t.`son_id`)) AS CHAR(1000)) AS path, CAST(CONCAT(b.cycle_key, '|', TRIM(t.`son_id`), '#', TRIM(t.`son_no`)) AS CHAR(2000)) AS cycle_key, t.`bom_ver` AS bom_ver, l.`data_status` AS data_status FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t JOIN bom_tree b ON TRIM(t.`father_id`) = TRIM(b.son_id) JOIN bom_latest l ON t.`father_id` = l.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = l.`bom_ver` WHERE b.level_no < 10 AND b.cycle_key NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(t.`son_id`), '#', TRIM(t.`son_no`), '%') AND TRIM(t.`son_id`) <> '' AND t.`data_status` = '已审核' ) SELECT bom_id, level_no, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(son_no), '') AS UNSIGNED) AS son_no, father_id, father_name, current_code, current_name, son_id, son_name, unit, fenzi, fenmu, path, bom_ver AS bomVer, data_status AS dataStatus FROM bom_tree WHERE son_id IS NOT NULL OR level_no = 0 ORDER BY level_no, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(son_no), '') AS UNSIGNED), current_code
